build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where a ball falls off a slanted obstacle using define_task_template
create_static_obstacle: create a slanted static bar obstacle with configurable angle and position in the PHYRE scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned over an obstacle in the PHYRE scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the bottom wall using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising SkipTemplateParams when the ball is not over the obstacle
